sourceDate.text: 與於越耶律釋魯同知國政
挈其二子叠裏特、朔刮奔渤海

label.en: ürün chijin of the Diela tribe
Grand Marshal of all armies under Heaven

claims.assessment: eyes bear the look of a rebel
wicked beyond words; instigated brothers' rebellion

translationRepairs: During the reign of Khan Hendejin of the Yaolian line, his elder half-brother Angu'zhi served as ürün chijin of the Yaonian tribe.
During the reign of Khan Hendejin of the Yaolian line, his elder half-brother Angu'zhi served as ürün chijin of the Diela tribe.
s0020 has 叠剌部夷離堇, so Angu'zhi's office is ürün chijin of the Diela tribe; 遙輦 names only Khan Hendejin's line, and the proposed replacement corrects that mislabel without other change.
Yaonian replied, "Great undertakings require men like him;
Diela replied, "Great undertakings require men like him;
After Taizu addresses his brothers, 叠剌曰 marks the speaker as Diela; rendering him as Yaonian invents the wrong name, and the proposed idiomatic correctly restores Diela.
Yaonian said: "One who plots a great undertaking must employ men such as this;
Diela said: "One who plots a great undertaking must employ men such as this;
The literal field likewise mistook 叠剌 for Yaonian; s0040's 叠剌曰 is the personal name Diela, and the proposed literal replacement is accurate.
Xiadǐ said, "The Yaonian tribe is large and strong, which is why it so often rebels; divide it in two to weaken its power."
Xiadǐ said, "The Diela tribe is large and strong, which is why it so often rebels; divide it in two to weaken its power."
Xiadǐ's counsel names 叠剌部, the Diela tribe; calling it the Yaonian tribe contradicts the Chinese, and the proposed idiomatic restores the correct tribal name.
Xiadǐ, whose style name was Nieliegun, was the son of Dila, ürün chijin of the Yaonian tribe and a descendant of the dynastic founder Suzu.
Xiadǐ, whose style name was Nieliegun, was the son of the ürün chijin Dila, who was a grandson of Suzu.
肅祖孫夷離堇怗剌之子 makes Dila both ürün chijin and Suzu's grandson, and Xiadǐ his son; the original invents a Yaonian-tribe office and misattaches 孫, while the proposed wording matches the Chinese.
His follower Shengsi alerted Shou'an and Wuzhi that troops had surrounded them outside; Chaguo then sent men to murder the empress before the coffin and hurried out to give battle in confusion.
His follower Shengsi reported that Shou'an and Wuzhi had surrounded them outside with troops; Chaguo then sent men to murder the empress before the coffin and hurried out to give battle in confusion.

其黨矧斯報壽安、屋質以兵圍於外 means Chaguo's partisan Shengsi reported that Shou'an and Wuzhi had surrounded them outside with troops; the original reverses alert recipient and surrounding force, and the proposal fixes that.
